capabilities.name: conversation.read
capabilities.lets: Read bots' conversations and follow them live; sealed card fields never reach it

capabilities.name: conversation.post
capabilities.lets: Add a note to a conversation, or send a bot a message; a turn it starts is the plugin's, never the user's
capabilities.ok: adds notes and sends messages to bots

capabilities.name: bots.read
capabilities.lets: Read the list of bots and their settings
capabilities.ok: sees your bots and their settings

capabilities.name: routines.read
capabilities.lets: Read the list of routines and their runs
capabilities.ok: sees your routines and their runs

capabilities.name: computers.read
capabilities.lets: Read the computer registry: each computer's folders, level and state
capabilities.ok: sees your computers, their folders and levels

capabilities.name: computers.control
capabilities.lets: Take and release holds and the user-working mark, learn where Clover's windows are, and say when an action is running
capabilities.ok: controls the screen and input of your computers

capabilities.name: approvals
capabilities.lets: Hear which cards are pending, never their text, and place their sealed frames

capabilities.name: files
capabilities.lets: Read and write files through the folder tree, inside the fence
capabilities.ok: reads and writes files on your computers

capabilities.name: browser
capabilities.lets: Drive the Clover Browser through its API

capabilities.name: usage.read
capabilities.lets: Read usage rows and plan readings
capabilities.ok: sees your usage and plan readings

capabilities.name: logs.read
capabilities.lets: Read Clover's logs and every plugin's

capabilities.name: notify
capabilities.lets: Send the user a notification through the notifiers

capabilities.name: audio
capabilities.lets: Record and play audio through the app; it records only while push-to-talk is held, unless the user turns listening on

capabilities.name: network:<host>
capabilities.lets: Reach that host through the core's fetch, which adds the plugin's own keys and tokens, and from the plugin's components, which reach no other host

corePoints.name: bot
corePoints.doc: Builds `<bot-instructions>`, picks the default model, keys memory by the bot's id (§6).

corePoints.name: models
corePoints.runsOn: every computer running a session; started when first needed
corePoints.doc: Calls the adapter, or the declared endpoint, for every turn; the welcome guide reads the sign-in methods (§3.3).
corePoints.shipsWith: every provider today's agent SDK has

corePoints.name: mcpServers
corePoints.runsOn: local servers on each computer they are installed on; remote servers on the computer running the session (§9.1)
corePoints.doc: Dispatches tool calls, builds the MCP block and shows MCP Apps pages.

corePoints.name: skills
corePoints.doc: Indexes them in `Glossary` (§6.8).

corePoints.name: agents
corePoints.doc: Offers these presets to `Agent`: backend, model, effort, instructions, computer, root folder, plugins (§9.3).

corePoints.name: agentBackends
corePoints.runsOn: the computer the agent is placed on
corePoints.doc: Starts agents for `Agent`: an ACP agent or a vendor cloud agent (§9.3).
corePoints.shipsWith: Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Gemini CLI, DeepSeek, Winter's coding agent

corePoints.name: hooks
corePoints.runsOn: every computer running a session; started when first needed
corePoints.doc: Calls them in the turn loop; a hook can block or adjust, never replace the runtime or skip approvals.

corePoints.name: commands
corePoints.doc: Runs a plugin's public functions for any client at once, with no model turn (§5.4).

corePoints.name: triggers
corePoints.doc: Arms them for routine files (§7).

corePoints.name: voices
corePoints.runsOn: the computer the user is talking on
corePoints.doc: Speech-to-text and text-to-speech for the bot's voice choice (§6.6).

corePoints.name: computerProviders
corePoints.doc: Creates, resizes and deletes the VMs that cloud computer folders describe (§9.2).

corePoints.name: computer
corePoints.doc: A cloud computer, created after the user's OK (§9.2).

corePoints.name: relays
corePoints.doc: Carries encrypted traffic when two devices can't connect directly, or holds encrypted sync mail (§8.3).
corePoints.shipsWith: n0's public relays; the cloud computer relay

corePoints.name: notifiers
corePoints.doc: Wakes companions when something happens (§10).

corePoints.name: companions
corePoints.doc: Serves a remote client within the fixed list of remote calls (§10).

corePoints.name: themes
corePoints.doc: Applies the base theme, the user's global theme and each bot's theme in its tab (§5.5).

corePoints.name: app.root
corePoints.doc: Mounts the main window's root: the shell (§5.5).

corePoints.name: app.surface
corePoints.doc: Opens top-level floating windows.

corePoints.name: bot.tab
corePoints.doc: Holds each bot's tab, which the shell shows.

corePoints.name: locales
corePoints.doc: Supplies strings for the core's own text and each plugin's keys, in the user's language (§5.5).

dataPoints.name: webhook.ingress
dataPoints.doc: Ways for webhooks to reach a device: the waifucave forwarder, the user's cloud computer, a tunnel (§7).

dataPoints.name: avatar.packs
dataPoints.doc: Avatar files with their format and portrait, so an avatar pack is a data plugin (§5.5).
